idea: Pick a fair random sample from a stream when you do not know its length and can read it only once. Keep the first K items. For the item at position i after that, pick a random number from 1 to i; if it is at most K, the item replaces that slot, otherwise it is dropped. At the end every item had exactly the same chance, K over n.
useWhen: Sampling from logs or data too large to store
Choosing a random line from a file you read once
Any stream whose length is unknown until it ends
avoidWhen: The whole list fits in memory and its length is known: shuffle or pick random positions
You need a sample weighted by importance: use a weighted variant
